limits: Net membership, CAD constraints and reference geometry only; connectivity must also pass KiCad DRC.
MPU core check rejects pad/artwork copper and paste inside the documented 3.08mm square; planes are allowed, track/via exclusion is additionally checked by KiCad DRC.
Ground-zone presence does not establish continuous return paths.
Track-length totals count all branches, not terminal-to-terminal electrical lengths.
No impedance/current-capacity, physical assembly, thermal, RF, timing or field performance claim.
